"""Exact posted-speed construction entrypoint, gated on a reviewed site."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import importlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

from posted_site import CASES, load


ASSIGNMENT = "testing__C136559__NRS-484B-600-1c__motor_vehicle_driver"


def check(root: Path) -> dict:
    config = json.loads((root / "config.json").read_text())
    exact = config.get("selected_case_id")
    suffix = exact.rsplit("__", 1)[-1] if isinstance(exact, str) else None
    if suffix not in CASES or exact != ASSIGNMENT + "__" + suffix:
        raise ValueError("exact posted-speed case mismatch")
    if (config.get("assignment_id"), config.get("law_id"), config.get("cell_id"), config.get("actor")) != (
            ASSIGNMENT, "NRS-484B-600-1c", "C136559", "motor_vehicle_driver"):
        raise ValueError("posted-speed scope mismatch")
    if (config.get("rate_hz"), config.get("frame_count"), config.get("duration_s")) != (20, 900, 45):
        raise ValueError("original 20 Hz capture contract changed")
    if [camera.get("name") for camera in config.get("cameras", [])] != [
            "overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference"]:
        raise ValueError("four-view capture contract changed")
    if config.get("case", {}).get("case_id") != exact:
        raise ValueError("selected case and construction disagree")
    return config


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--site", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--site-sha256")
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--host")
    parser.add_argument("--port")
    parser.add_argument("--adapter-module")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    config = check(Path(__file__).resolve().parent)
    if args.check:
        print(config["selected_case_id"])
        return
    site = args.site or (Path(os.environ["C136559_POSTED_SITE"]) if os.environ.get("C136559_POSTED_SITE") else None)
    site_sha = args.site_sha256 or os.environ.get("C136559_POSTED_SITE_SHA256")
    module = args.adapter_module or os.environ.get("C136559_NATIVE_ADAPTER_MODULE") or "native_adapter"
    if site is None or not site_sha or args.output_dir is None:
        raise ValueError("reviewed posted-speed site, hash and output directory required")
    packet = load(site, site_sha, config["selected_case_id"])
    variables = config["case"]["draft_variables"]
    if variables["travel_direction"] not in packet["travel_lanes"]:
        raise ValueError("selected direction lacks reviewed lane")
    from native_capture import capture
    adapter = importlib.import_module(module).create_adapter(config, args.host, args.port, args.output_dir)
    print(json.dumps(capture(adapter, config, site, site_sha, args.output_dir), sort_keys=True))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Source-gated Native posted-speed capture using a supplied CARLA adapter.

The adapter owns simulator calls. This module owns exact case, source, frame,
camera, controller and teardown contracts before saved-only processing.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import math
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

from posted_control import command, target_speed
from posted_site import load


VIEWS = ("overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference")


def sha(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def write(path: Path, value: dict) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True) + "\n")


def capture(adapter, config: dict, site_path: Path, site_sha256: str, output: Path) -> dict:
    case_id = config["selected_case_id"]
    site = load(site_path, site_sha256, case_id)
    output = Path(output).resolve()
    if not (output / "construction.json").is_file() or (output / "original-attempt").exists():
        raise ValueError("materialized unused exact attempt required")
    original = output / "original-attempt"
    original.mkdir()
    shutil.copy2(site_path, original / "site.json")
    if sha(original / "site.json") != site_sha256:
        raise ValueError("reviewed site changed during capture")
    variables = config["case"]["draft_variables"]
    target = target_speed(site, variables)
    gain = config["control"]["tracking_gain"]
    lane_id = site["travel_lanes"][variables["travel_direction"]]
    owned = []
    frames, motion, route, traces, mappings, video_rows = [], [], [], [], [], []
    restored = False
    try:
        adapter.setup(config, site)
        ego = adapter.spawn_ego(lane_id, config)
        owned.append(ego)
        cameras = adapter.attach_cameras(ego, config["cameras"])
        if set(cameras) != set(VIEWS):
            raise ValueError("four original cameras absent")
        actual = 0.0
        first_frame = None
        for index in range(900):
            throttle, brake = command(actual, target, gain)
            adapter.apply_control(ego, throttle, brake)
            sample = adapter.tick_and_read(ego, cameras)
            frame, time = sample.get("frame"), sample.get("time_s")
            if first_frame is None:
                first_frame = frame
            if type(frame) is not int or frame != first_frame + index or \
                    type(time) not in (int, float) or abs(time - index / 20) > .005:
                raise ValueError("original frame/time gap")
            speed = sample.get("speed_mps")
            if type(speed) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(speed) or speed < 0:
                raise ValueError("original vehicle speed invalid")
            actual = speed
            if set(sample.get("camera_png", {})) != set(VIEWS) or any(
                    not isinstance(sample["camera_png"][name], bytes) or
                    not sample["camera_png"][name].startswith(b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n")
                    for name in VIEWS):
                raise ValueError("original synchronized camera frame missing")
            direction = sample.get("direction")
            if not all(isinstance(sample.get(key), str) and sample[key] for key in
                       ("road_id", "segment_id", "direction")) or \
                    type(sample.get("on_highway")) is not bool or \
                    type(sample.get("operating")) is not bool:
                raise ValueError("original route occupancy missing")
            trace = sample.get("trace")
            video = sample.get("video_frame")
            if not isinstance(trace, dict) or trace.get("frame") != frame or \
                    trace.get("time_s") != time or not isinstance(video, dict) or \
                    video.get("carla_frame") != frame or video.get("time_s") != time:
                raise ValueError("original trace/video frame join missing")
            frames.append({"frame": frame, "time_s": time,
                           "camera_sha256": {name: hashlib.sha256(sample["camera_png"][name]).hexdigest()
                                             for name in VIEWS}})
            motion.append({"frame": frame, "time_s": time,
                           "vehicle_id": site["vehicle_id"], "speed_mps": speed})
            route.append({"frame": frame, "time_s": time, "road_id": sample["road_id"],
                          "segment_id": sample["segment_id"], "direction": direction,
                          "on_highway": sample["on_highway"], "operating": sample["operating"]})
            traces.append(trace)
            video_rows.append(video)
            mappings.append({"video_frame": index, "carla_frame": frame, "time_s": time})
        media = adapter.finalize_media(output, VIEWS, tuple(mappings))
        if set(media) != set(VIEWS) | {"raw"} or any(
                Path(media[name]).resolve() != (output / (name + ".mkv")).resolve() or
                not Path(media[name]).is_file() or Path(media[name]).stat().st_size == 0
                for name in media):
            raise ValueError("original encoded media incomplete")
    finally:
        for actor in reversed(owned):
            adapter.destroy(actor)
        restored = adapter.close() is True
    if not restored or len(frames) != 900:
        raise ValueError("original capture or simulator restoration incomplete")
    control = {key: site[key] for key in (
        "case_id", "rate", "unit", "vehicle_id", "highway_dedication_source",
        "public_access_source", "narrow_road_geometry_source", "vehicle_clearance_source",
        "governed_segment_source", "governed_direction_source", "sign_position_source",
        "posting_authority_source", "public_authority_posted", "sign_in_camera_view",
        "governed_road_id", "governed_segment_id", "governed_direction")}
    control["source_kind"] = "original_native_context"
    if "off_camera_reading_assumption_source" in site:
        control["off_camera_reading_assumption_source"] = site["off_camera_reading_assumption_source"]
    packets = {"frame_map": {"frames": frames},
               "vehicle_motion": {"case_id": case_id, "source_kind": "original_native", "samples": motion},
               "route_occupancy": {"case_id": case_id, "source_kind": "original_native", "samples": route},
               "posted_control": control}
    sources = {}
    for name, packet in packets.items():
        path = original / (name + ".json")
        write(path, packet)
        sources[name] = {"path": path.name, "sha256": sha(path)}
    (output / "trace.jsonl").write_text("".join(json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True) + "\n" for row in traces))
    (output / "video_frames.jsonl").write_text("".join(json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True) + "\n" for row in video_rows))
    media_inventory = {}
    for name in VIEWS:
        shutil.copy2(output / (name + ".mkv"), original / (name + ".mkv"))
        media_inventory[name] = {"path": name + ".mkv", "sha256": sha(original / (name + ".mkv"))}
    shutil.copy2(output / "trace.jsonl", original / "trace.jsonl")
    media_inventory["trace"] = {"path": "trace.jsonl", "sha256": sha(original / "trace.jsonl")}
    write(original / "inventory.json", {"case_id": case_id, "source_kind": "original_native",
                                        "sources": sources, "media": media_inventory,
                                        "diagnostic_fixture": False})
    write(original / "posted-speed-source.json", {"case_id": case_id,
                                                   "source_kind": "original_native",
                                                   "diagnostic_fixture": False})
    sealed = {str(path.relative_to(output)): sha(path) for path in output.rglob("*") if path.is_file()}
    write(output / "capture-seal.json", {
        "events": ["capture_finished", "encoders_closed", "restoration_verified"],
        "sources": sealed,
        "native_revision": {"construction_sha256": sha(output / "construction.json"),
                            "runner_sha256": sha(output / "runner.py")}})
    return {"case_id": case_id, "frame_count": 900,
            "physical_acceptance_claimed": False, "legal_acceptance_claimed": False}

"""Saved-only posted-speed finalizer; diagnostic and original sources stay distinct."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path


VIEWS = ("overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference")


def required(root: Path, relative: str) -> Path:
    path = root / relative
    if not path.is_file():
        raise ValueError("Missing required source: " + relative)
    return path


def sha(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def build(attempt: Path) -> tuple[dict, dict]:
    attempt = Path(attempt).resolve()
    config = json.loads(required(attempt, "config.json").read_text())
    construction = json.loads(required(attempt, "construction.json").read_text())
    case_id = config["selected_case_id"]
    if construction["case_id"] != case_id:
        raise ValueError("selected posted-speed construction changed")
    specific = required(attempt, "original-attempt/posted-speed-source.json")
    packet = json.loads(specific.read_text())
    diagnostic = packet.get("diagnostic_fixture") is True
    if packet.get("case_id") != case_id:
        raise ValueError("posted-speed finalizer exact case mismatch")
    if diagnostic:
        if packet.get("source_kind") != "synthetic_fixture" or not isinstance(packet.get("samples"), list) or len(packet["samples"]) != 9:
            raise ValueError("diagnostic posted-speed sample contract invalid")
        measurement = {"diagnostic_samples": packet["samples"],
                       "source_kind": "synthetic_fixture",
                       "legal_applicability": "unresolved"}
    else:
        from original_source_audit import audit as audit_original
        from speed_source_review import measure as measure_original
        inventory = json.loads(required(attempt, "original-attempt/inventory.json").read_text())
        source_receipt = audit_original(attempt / "original-attempt", inventory, case_id)
        measurement = measure_original(attempt / "original-attempt", inventory, case_id)
        measurement["source_audit"] = source_receipt
    traces = [json.loads(line) for line in required(attempt, "trace.jsonl").read_text().splitlines() if line]
    mapping = [json.loads(line) for line in required(attempt, "video_frames.jsonl").read_text().splitlines() if line]
    if not traces or len(traces) != len(mapping):
        raise ValueError("posted-speed trace/video frame join incomplete")
    for name in VIEWS:
        required(attempt, name + ".mkv")
    channels = attempt / "channels"
    if channels.exists():
        raise ValueError("refusing to overwrite original speed channels")
    channels.mkdir()
    path = channels / "actual_speed_mps.jsonl"
    rows = packet["samples"] if diagnostic else measurement["samples"]
    path.write_text("".join(json.dumps({"time_s": row.get("time_s"),
                                        "value": row["speed_mps"]}, sort_keys=True) + "\n"
                            for row in rows))
    context = channels / "context.json"
    context.write_text(json.dumps({"reviewed_posted_site": {
        "sha256": sha(specific),
        "review_status": "synthetic fixture" if diagnostic else "pending independent original review"}},
        sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    sources = {"original-attempt/posted-speed-source.json": sha(specific)}
    report = {"format": "worker-analysis-report", "case_id": case_id,
              "analysis_complete": True, "legal_verdict_claimed": False,
              "measurements": {"posted_speed_history": {"value": measurement,
                                                     "method": "build", "sources": sources}},
              "limitations": ["Original posted authority, actual capture and legal applicability require independent review."]}
    result = {"case_id": case_id, "measured_values": measurement,
              "target_checks": [{"target": "original posted-speed passage",
                                 "requested": config["case"]["draft_variables"],
                                 "measured": measurement, "method": "build",
                                 "tolerance": None, "matched": False,
                                 "physical_cause_confirmed": False,
                                 "cause_evidence": sources}],
              "setup_confirmed": False, "behavior_attempted": False,
              "maneuver_completed": False,
              "termination_reason": "original physical and legal review pending",
              "physical_failure_flags": [], "trace_reference": "trace.jsonl",
              "video_references": [name + ".mkv" for name in VIEWS],
              "video_frame_map_reference": "video_frames.jsonl",
              "recording_description": construction["recording_description"],
              "recording_evidence": [{"name": "actual_speed_mps", "unit": "m/s",
                                      "reference": "channels/actual_speed_mps.jsonl"},
                                     {"name": "reviewed_posted_site", "unit": "source record",
                                      "reference": "channels/context.json"}],
              "realized_observables": {},
              "provenance_kind": "synthetic_fixture" if diagnostic else "native",
              "diagnostic_fixture": diagnostic, "physical_acceptance_claimed": False}
    return report, result


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--attempt", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.output.exists():
        raise ValueError("refusing to overwrite posted-speed analysis report")
    report, result = build(args.attempt)
    from worker_exchange.native_output import write_result
    write_result(args.attempt, result)
    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Source-bound original speed and posted-governing-portion review.

This measures strict numeric speed differences. Authority, road applicability,
and a sign outside camera view require independent source evidence.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import math
from decimal import Decimal, localcontext
from pathlib import Path


ASSIGNMENT = "testing__C136559__NRS-484B-600-1c__motor_vehicle_driver"
SOURCES = ("frame_map", "vehicle_motion", "route_occupancy", "posted_control")
UNIT_TO_MPS = {"mph": 0.44704, "km/h": 1 / 3.6, "m/s": 1.0}


def _source(root: Path, entry: dict) -> dict:
    rel = Path(entry["path"])
    if rel.is_absolute() or ".." in rel.parts:
        raise ValueError("original posted-speed source path escapes attempt")
    path = (root / rel).resolve()
    if not path.is_relative_to(root.resolve()) or not path.is_file():
        raise ValueError("original posted-speed source missing")
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != entry["sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("original posted-speed source hash mismatch")
    return json.loads(raw)


def measure(root: Path, inventory: dict, case_id: str) -> dict:
    root = Path(root)
    if not case_id.startswith(ASSIGNMENT + "__") or inventory.get("case_id") != case_id:
        raise ValueError("exact posted-speed case mismatch")
    if inventory.get("source_kind") != "original_native":
        raise ValueError("original Native source required")
    sources = inventory.get("sources")
    if not isinstance(sources, dict) or set(sources) != set(SOURCES):
        raise ValueError("complete posted-speed original source inventory required")
    packets = {name: _source(root, sources[name]) for name in SOURCES}
    frames = packets["frame_map"].get("frames")
    if not isinstance(frames, list) or len(frames) < 900:
        raise ValueError("original 900-frame history missing")
    first = frames[0].get("frame")
    if type(first) is not int or [r.get("frame") for r in frames] != list(range(first, first + len(frames))):
        raise ValueError("original frame sequence not consecutive")
    times = [r.get("time_s") for r in frames]
    if any(type(t) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(t) for t in times) or any(
            abs(b - a - .05) > .005 for a, b in zip(times, times[1:])):
        raise ValueError("original frame clock not 20 Hz")
    motion = packets["vehicle_motion"]
    route = packets["route_occupancy"]
    for name, packet in (("vehicle motion", motion), ("route occupancy", route)):
        if packet.get("case_id") != case_id or packet.get("source_kind") != "original_native":
            raise ValueError(f"{name} original identity mismatch")
        if not isinstance(packet.get("samples"), list) or len(packet["samples"]) != len(frames):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} original history incomplete")
    control = packets["posted_control"]
    if (control.get("source_kind") != "original_native_context" or
            control.get("case_id") != case_id or
            control.get("unit") not in UNIT_TO_MPS or
            type(control.get("rate")) not in (int, float) or control["rate"] <= 0 or
            not math.isfinite(control["rate"]) or
            not control.get("highway_dedication_source") or
            not control.get("public_access_source") or
            not control.get("narrow_road_geometry_source") or
            not control.get("vehicle_clearance_source") or
            not control.get("governed_segment_source") or
            not control.get("governed_direction_source") or
            not control.get("sign_position_source") or
            not control.get("posting_authority_source") or
            type(control.get("public_authority_posted")) is not bool or
            type(control.get("sign_in_camera_view")) is not bool or
            not control.get("vehicle_id") or
            not control.get("governed_road_id") or
            not control.get("governed_segment_id") or
            not control.get("governed_direction")):
        raise ValueError("original posted control and highway provenance incomplete")
    if not control["sign_in_camera_view"] and not control.get("off_camera_reading_assumption_source"):
        raise ValueError("off-camera governing limit remains unknown without reading assumption")
    with localcontext() as context:
        context.prec = 50
        source_rate = Decimal(str(control["rate"]))
        if control["unit"] == "mph":
            rate_mps = source_rate * Decimal("0.44704")
        elif control["unit"] == "km/h":
            rate_mps = source_rate * Decimal(5) / Decimal(18)
        else:
            rate_mps = source_rate
    samples = []
    for frame, m, r in zip(frames, motion["samples"], route["samples"]):
        for name, row in (("motion", m), ("route", r)):
            if row.get("frame") != frame["frame"] or row.get("time_s") != frame["time_s"]:
                raise ValueError(f"original {name} frame/time join mismatch")
        if (m.get("vehicle_id") != control["vehicle_id"] or
                type(m.get("speed_mps")) not in (int, float) or
                not math.isfinite(m["speed_mps"]) or m["speed_mps"] < 0):
            raise ValueError("original vehicle speed or identity invalid")
        if (not isinstance(r.get("road_id"), str) or
                not isinstance(r.get("segment_id"), str) or
                not isinstance(r.get("direction"), str)):
            raise ValueError("original occupied road, portion or direction missing")
        if type(r.get("on_highway")) is not bool or type(r.get("operating")) is not bool:
            raise ValueError("original highway/operation state missing")
        governed = (r["on_highway"] and r["operating"] and
                    r["road_id"] == control["governed_road_id"] and
                    r["segment_id"] == control["governed_segment_id"] and
                    r["direction"] == control["governed_direction"] and
                    control["public_authority_posted"])
        with localcontext() as context:
            context.prec = 50
            difference = Decimal(str(m["speed_mps"])) - rate_mps if governed else None
        samples.append({"frame": frame["frame"], "time_s": frame["time_s"],
                        "speed_mps": m["speed_mps"], "governed_portion": governed,
                        "rate_difference_mps": float(difference) if governed else None,
                        "above_posted_rate": difference > 0 if governed else None})
    return {"format": "c136559-original-posted-speed-v1", "case_id": case_id,
            "source_sha256": {name: sources[name]["sha256"] for name in SOURCES},
            "original_frames": len(frames), "posted_rate": control["rate"],
            "posted_unit": control["unit"], "posted_rate_mps": float(rate_mps),
            "public_authority_posted": control["public_authority_posted"],
            "sign_in_camera_view": control["sign_in_camera_view"],
            "governed_frames": sum(row["governed_portion"] for row in samples),
            "observed_above_frames": sum(row["above_posted_rate"] is True for row in samples),
            "samples": samples, "legal_applicability_and_priority": "unresolved"}


def main() -> None:
    import argparse
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--attempt", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--case", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.output.exists():
        raise ValueError("refusing to overwrite original speed review")
    inventory = json.loads((args.attempt / "inventory.json").read_text())
    result = measure(args.attempt, inventory, args.case)
    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")

"""Source-bound CARLA bridge for original posted-speed attempts.

CARLA is imported only by create_adapter. All Native geometry comes from the
independently reviewed, hash-bound site packet. The bridge observes actual
motion and pixels; it does not assert physical or legal acceptance.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import io
import json
import math
import queue
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from PIL import Image

VIEWS = ("overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference")


def native_plan(site: dict, map_opendrive: str) -> dict:
    native = site.get("native")
    if not isinstance(native, dict):
        raise ValueError("reviewed Native geometry packet required")
    digest = hashlib.sha256(map_opendrive.encode()).hexdigest()
    if native.get("map_opendrive_sha256") != digest:
        raise ValueError("reviewed OpenDRIVE map readback differs")
    if not native.get("vehicle_blueprint_id") or not native.get("spawn"):
        raise ValueError("reviewed vehicle blueprint and spawn required")
    poses = native.get("camera_poses")
    if not isinstance(poses, dict) or set(poses) != set(VIEWS):
        raise ValueError("four reviewed original camera poses required")
    for pose in [native["spawn"], *poses.values()]:
        if not isinstance(pose, dict) or any(type(pose.get(k)) not in (int, float) or
                                             not math.isfinite(pose[k])
                                             for k in ("x", "y", "z", "pitch", "yaw", "roll")):
            raise ValueError("finite reviewed Native pose required")
    segments = native.get("segments")
    if not isinstance(segments, list) or not segments:
        raise ValueError("reviewed route segment stations required")
    for item in segments:
        if not isinstance(item, dict) or not isinstance(item.get("road_id"), int) or \
                not item.get("segment_id") or type(item.get("on_highway")) is not bool or \
                type(item.get("s_start")) not in (int, float) or \
                type(item.get("s_end")) not in (int, float) or \
                not 0 <= item["s_start"] < item["s_end"]:
            raise ValueError("reviewed route segment definition invalid")
    return native


def route_readback(waypoint, site: dict, native: dict) -> dict:
    lane = str(waypoint.lane_id)
    directions = [name for name, reviewed in site["travel_lanes"].items()
                  if str(reviewed) == lane]
    if len(directions) != 1:
        raise ValueError("actual Native lane lacks reviewed direction")
    segments = [item for item in native["segments"]
                if item["road_id"] == waypoint.road_id and
                item["s_start"] <= waypoint.s < item["s_end"]]
    if len(segments) != 1:
        raise ValueError("actual Native station lacks unique reviewed highway segment")
    item = segments[0]
    return {"road_id": str(waypoint.road_id), "segment_id": item["segment_id"],
            "direction": directions[0], "on_highway": item["on_highway"]}


def pose(carla, item: dict):
    return carla.Transform(carla.Location(x=item["x"], y=item["y"], z=item["z"]),
                           carla.Rotation(pitch=item["pitch"], yaw=item["yaw"], roll=item["roll"]))


class OriginalAdapter:
    def __init__(self, config: dict, host: str, port: int, output: Path, carla, client=None):
        self.config, self.carla = config, carla
        self.output = Path(output).resolve()
        self.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.client = client or carla.Client(host, int(port))
        self.client.set_timeout(30.0)
        self.world = self.client.get_world()
        self.original_settings = None
        self.site = None
        self.native = None
        self.sensors = []
        self.encoders = {}
        self.encoder_logs = {}
        self.queues = {}
        self.first_elapsed = None
        self.index = 0
        self.media_closed = False

    def setup(self, config: dict, site: dict) -> None:
        self.native = native_plan(site, self.world.get_map().to_opendrive())
        self.site = site
        self.original_settings = self.world.get_settings()
        settings = self.world.get_settings()
        settings.synchronous_mode = True
        settings.fixed_delta_seconds = 0.05
        self.world.apply_settings(settings)
        readback = self.world.get_settings()
        if not readback.synchronous_mode or abs(readback.fixed_delta_seconds - .05) > 1e-6:
            raise ValueError("Native 20 Hz world readback failed")

    def spawn_ego(self, lane_id: str, config: dict):
        blueprint = self.world.get_blueprint_library().find(self.native["vehicle_blueprint_id"])
        if blueprint is None or not blueprint.id.startswith("vehicle."):
            raise ValueError("reviewed motor-vehicle blueprint unavailable")
        ego = self.world.try_spawn_actor(blueprint, pose(self.carla, self.native["spawn"]))
        if ego is None:
            raise ValueError("reviewed Native ego spawn obstructed")
        waypoint = self.world.get_map().get_waypoint(ego.get_location(), project_to_road=False)
        if waypoint is None or str(waypoint.lane_id) != str(lane_id):
            ego.destroy()
            raise ValueError("reviewed spawn lane readback differs")
        return ego

    def attach_cameras(self, ego, cameras: list) -> dict:
        if self.sensors or self.encoders:
            raise ValueError("original cameras already attached")
        sensors = {}
        try:
            for spec in cameras:
                name = spec["name"]
                if name not in VIEWS or name in sensors:
                    raise ValueError("unexpected original camera")
                blueprint = self.world.get_blueprint_library().find("sensor.camera.rgb")
                blueprint.set_attribute("image_size_x", str(spec["width"]))
                blueprint.set_attribute("image_size_y", str(spec["height"]))
                blueprint.set_attribute("fov", str(spec["fov_deg"]))
                blueprint.set_attribute("sensor_tick", "0.05")
                sensor = self.world.spawn_actor(blueprint,
                                                pose(self.carla, self.native["camera_poses"][name]),
                                                attach_to=ego)
                stream = queue.Queue(maxsize=8)
                sensor.listen(lambda image, target=stream: target.put(image, timeout=5))
                self.queues[name] = stream
                self.sensors.append(sensor)
                sensors[name] = sensor
                self._open_encoder(name)
            if set(sensors) != set(VIEWS):
                raise ValueError("original four-view camera set incomplete")
            self._open_encoder("raw")
            return sensors
        except Exception:
            for sensor in reversed(self.sensors):
                sensor.stop()
                sensor.destroy()
            self.sensors.clear()
            self._finish_encoders()
            raise

    def _open_encoder(self, name: str) -> None:
        output = self.output / (name + ".mkv")
        if output.exists():
            raise ValueError("original media destination already exists")
        log = (self.output / ("encoder-" + name + ".log")).open("wb")
        command = ["ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error",
                   "-f", "image2pipe", "-framerate", "20", "-vcodec", "png",
                   "-i", "pipe:0", "-an", "-c:v", "ffv1", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p",
                   str(output)]
        process = subprocess.Popen(command, stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                                   stderr=log)
        self.encoders[name] = process
        self.encoder_logs[name] = log

    def apply_control(self, ego, throttle: float, brake: float) -> None:
        waypoint = self.world.get_map().get_waypoint(ego.get_location(), project_to_road=False)
        if waypoint is None:
            raise ValueError("ego left reviewed roadway")
        successors = waypoint.next(8.0)
        if not successors:
            raise ValueError("reviewed route ends before capture")
        target = successors[0].transform.location
        current = ego.get_transform()
        dx, dy = target.x - current.location.x, target.y - current.location.y
        wanted = math.degrees(math.atan2(dy, dx))
        error = (wanted - current.rotation.yaw + 180) % 360 - 180
        steer = max(-1.0, min(1.0, error / 35.0))
        ego.apply_control(self.carla.VehicleControl(throttle=float(throttle),
                                                    brake=float(brake), steer=steer))

    def tick_and_read(self, ego, cameras: dict) -> dict:
        frame = self.world.tick()
        snapshot = self.world.get_snapshot()
        if snapshot.frame != frame:
            raise ValueError("Native frame snapshot differs")
        if self.first_elapsed is None:
            self.first_elapsed = snapshot.timestamp.elapsed_seconds
        time_s = snapshot.timestamp.elapsed_seconds - self.first_elapsed
        waypoint = self.world.get_map().get_waypoint(ego.get_location(), project_to_road=False)
        if waypoint is None:
            raise ValueError("original ego roadway readback missing")
        route = route_readback(waypoint, self.site, self.native)
        pixels = {}
        for name in VIEWS:
            try:
                image = self.queues[name].get(timeout=15)
            except queue.Empty as error:
                raise ValueError("original camera frame missing: " + name) from error
            if image.frame != frame:
                raise ValueError("original camera frame join differs: " + name)
            converted = Image.frombytes("RGBA", (image.width, image.height),
                                        bytes(image.raw_data), "raw", "BGRA").convert("RGB")
            memory = io.BytesIO()
            converted.save(memory, format="PNG")
            pixels[name] = memory.getvalue()
            self.encoders[name].stdin.write(pixels[name])
        self.encoders["raw"].stdin.write(pixels["overview"])
        velocity = ego.get_velocity()
        speed = math.sqrt(velocity.x ** 2 + velocity.y ** 2 + velocity.z ** 2)
        location = ego.get_location()
        trace = {"frame": frame, "time_s": time_s, "position":
                 {"x": location.x, "y": location.y, "z": location.z},
                 "speed_mps": speed, "road_id": route["road_id"],
                 "lane_id": str(waypoint.lane_id)}
        row = {"frame": frame, "time_s": time_s, "speed_mps": speed,
               "camera_png": pixels, "trace": trace,
               "video_frame": {"carla_frame": frame, "time_s": time_s,
                               "video_frame": self.index},
               "operating": ego.is_alive}
        row.update(route)
        self.index += 1
        return row

    def _finish_encoders(self) -> bool:
        if self.media_closed:
            return True
        passed = True
        for name, process in self.encoders.items():
            if process.stdin and not process.stdin.closed:
                process.stdin.close()
            if process.wait(timeout=90) != 0:
                passed = False
            self.encoder_logs[name].close()
        self.media_closed = True
        return passed

    def finalize_media(self, output: Path, views: tuple, mapping: tuple) -> dict:
        if tuple(views) != VIEWS or len(mapping) != 900 or self.index != 900:
            raise ValueError("original media frame map incomplete")
        if not self._finish_encoders():
            raise ValueError("original FFV1 encoder failed")
        media = {name: self.output / (name + ".mkv") for name in (*VIEWS, "raw")}
        if any(not path.is_file() or path.stat().st_size == 0 for path in media.values()):
            raise ValueError("original FFV1 stream missing")
        return media

    def destroy(self, actor) -> None:
        actor.destroy()

    def close(self) -> bool:
        passed = True
        for sensor in reversed(self.sensors):
            try:
                sensor.stop()
                sensor.destroy()
            except Exception:
                passed = False
        self.sensors.clear()
        try:
            passed = self._finish_encoders() and passed
        except Exception:
            passed = False
        if self.original_settings is not None:
            self.world.apply_settings(self.original_settings)
            readback = self.world.get_settings()
            passed = passed and readback.synchronous_mode == self.original_settings.synchronous_mode and \
                readback.fixed_delta_seconds == self.original_settings.fixed_delta_seconds
        return passed


def create_adapter(config: dict, host: str, port: int, output: Path):
    import carla
    return OriginalAdapter(config, host, port, output, carla)
